ICML 2026 · DIFFUSION PRIORS / INVERSE PROBLEMS

弱扩散先验也能取得强逆问题表现

Weak Diffusion Priors Can Still Achieve Strong Inverse-Problem Performance

Jing Jia* · Wei Yuan* · Sifan Liu · Liyue Shen · Guanyang Wang

这篇论文追问一个反直觉的现象：只用 3 步 DDIM、甚至在卧室图像上训练的低保真先验，为什么还能把人脸图像恢复好？作者给出两层解释——信息量充足的测量能让后验压过先验；而弱先验与强先验共享几乎相同的局部空间相关性。二者共同说明了弱先验何时可用、何时会失败。

读之前，先把这条链路分清

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (1)–(11) 时，知道每个量在做什么。

  1. 前向算子：测量写成 y=A(x)+ϵy=\mathcal{A}(x)+\epsilony=A(x)+ϵ，A\mathcal{A}A 把未知图像 xxx 映射到观测 yyy，ϵ\epsilonϵ 是高斯噪声。修补、去模糊、超分辨率都是不同的 A\mathcal{A}A。
  2. 先验的两个轴：「弱」可以指生成器少步数（低保真），也可以指训练域与目标域不匹配；两者可以同时成立。
  3. 初始噪声优化：把生成器 GGG 当黑盒，优化输入噪声 zzz，使 A(G(z))\mathcal{A}(G(z))A(G(z)) 拟合 yyy。步数少时反向传播便宜，这正是实践者被迫使用弱先验的原因。
  4. 分数（score）：本文指候选分量在测量上的平方残差（式 (4)），它与观测像素上的 MSE 成正比；分数间隔越大，最佳候选越容易被区分。
  5. 指标：PSNR、SSIM 越高越好，LPIPS 越低越好。
术语速查（译者注）
DPS
Diffusion Posterior Sampling，用完整扩散模型逐步注入测量信息的后验采样方法。
DDIM
确定性的扩散采样器；本文的弱先验通常是 3 步 DDIM。
INO
initial-noise optimization，初始噪声优化，本文方法的统称。
AdamSphere
本文提出的优化器，把噪声迭代点约束在半径 d\sqrt{d}d​ 的球面上。
HoldoutTopK
本文提出的早停规则：留出一部分测量，保留留出损失最好的前 KKK 个迭代并取其中最新者。
后验一致性
数据量增大时后验集中在真值附近的性质（定理 1、4）。

摘要

English original
Abstract

一个在卧室图像上训练的扩散模型，能恢复人脸吗？扩散模型被广泛用作逆问题的先验，但标准做法通常假设存在一个在高保真、且与未知信号分布高度匹配的数据上训练的模型。实际中，人们往往只能使用不匹配或低保真的扩散先验。令人惊讶的是，这些弱先验的表现常常几乎与全强度、域内基线一样好。我们研究逆问题求解器在什么情况下、以及为什么对弱扩散先验具有鲁棒性。通过大量实验，我们发现：当测量信息量很高（例如观测到大量像素）时弱先验能够成功，并识别出它们失败的区间。为解释这一行为，我们把贝叶斯一致性理论与局部相关性分析结合起来：理论给出了高维测量使后验集中在真实信号附近的条件，而相关性分析表明弱先验与更强的自然图像先验可以共享相似的局部空间结构。这些结果为「何时可以可靠地使用弱扩散先验」提供了有原则的依据。代码见 该仓库。

English original
Can a diffusion model trained on bedrooms recover human faces? Diffusion models are widely used as priors for inverse problems, but standard approaches usually assume a high-fidelity model trained on data that closely match the unknown signal. In practice, one often must use a mismatched or low-fidelity diffusion prior. Surprisingly, these weak priors often perform nearly as well as full-strength, in-domain baselines. We study when and why inverse solvers are robust to weak diffusion priors. Through extensive experiments, we find that weak priors succeed when measurements are highly informative (e.g., many observed pixels), and we identify regimes where they fail. To explain this behavior, we combine Bayesian-consistency theory with local-correlation analysis: the theory gives conditions under which high-dimensional measurements make the posterior concentrate near the true signal, while the correlation analysis shows that weak and stronger natural-image priors can share similar local spatial structure. These results provide a principled justification on when weak diffusion priors can be used reliably. Code is available at this repository.

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

逆问题旨在从含噪测量中恢复未知信号。近年来，扩散模型已成为逆问题的强大数据驱动先验，在计算机视觉及相关领域的广泛任务上取得了最先进的性能。标准范式使用同一个「全强度」扩散模型作为先验：例如，用在一个 1000 步 DDPM (Ho 等, 2020)、(Song 等, 2021)、并在人脸数据集上训练，来恢复人脸。在此基础上，现有求解器把扩散模型直接集成到重建过程中，在整条反向扩散链上注入测量信息，以强制与观测保持一致 (Song 等, 2021)、(Song 等, 2022)、(Chung 等, 2023)、(Kawar 等, 2022)、(Meng 与 Kabashima, 2024)、(Zhou 等, 2024)、(Song 等, 2024)。这一策略构成了基于扩散的逆问题求解的主流方法。

English original
Inverse problems aim to recover an unknown signal from noisy measurements. Recently, diffusion models have emerged as powerful data-driven priors for inverse problems, achieving state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tasks in computer vision and related fields. The standard paradigm employs the same ``full-strength” diffusion model as the prior: for example, a 100010001000-step DDPM (Ho et al., 2020); (Song et al., 2021) trained on a face dataset to recover human faces. Building on this, existing solvers integrate the diffusion model directly into reconstruction by injecting measurement information throughout a reverse diffusion chain to enforce consistency with the observation (Song et al., 2021); (Song et al., 2022); (Chung et al., 2023); (Kawar et al., 2022); (Meng & Kabashima, 2024); (Zhou et al., 2024); (Song et al., 2024). This strategy constitutes the mainstream approach for diffusion-based inverse problem solving.

然而，一个完全匹配、全强度的先验往往是一种奢侈。实际约束经常迫使我们使用「更弱的先验」，即推理时被大幅截断、或在不匹配的数据集上训练的扩散模型。例如，(Wang 等, 2024) 与 (Chihaoui 等, 2024) 提出优化初始噪声来求解逆问题。为满足显存限制，他们不得不把扩散过程剧烈截断到仅几步。于是先验本身受到严重限制：它只能生成低保真、模糊的图像（见图 1 中的 Iteration 1）。与此同时，在医学图像复原等数据稀缺的领域，训练数据的缺失使得构建特定领域的模型成为不可能。因此研究者常常折中，依赖来自完全不匹配分布的预训练模型 (Knoll 等, 2019)、(Jalal 等, 2021)、(Glaszner 与 Zach, 2024)、(Aali 等, 2025)、(Hu 等, 2025)、(Barbano 等, 2025)。

English original
However, the luxury of a perfectly matched, full-strength prior is often unavailable. Practical constraints often force us to use “weaker priors,” meaning diffusion models that are heavily truncated at inference or trained on a mismatched dataset. For example, (Wang et al., 2024) and (Chihaoui et al., 2024) propose optimizing the initial noise to solve inverse problems. To meet the memory constraints, they have to drastically truncate the diffusion process to just a few steps. Consequently, the prior itself is severely limited: it can only generate low-fidelity, blurry images (see Iteration 1 in Figure 1). In parallel, in data-scarce domains such as medical image restoration, the absence of training data precludes the creation of domain-specific models. Therefore, researchers often compromise by relying on pre-trained models from completely mismatched distributions (Knoll et al., 2019); (Jalal et al., 2021); (Glaszner & Zach, 2024); (Aali et al., 2025); (Hu et al., 2025); (Barbano et al., 2025).

令人惊讶的是，这些弱先验仍能给出极具竞争力的重建。例如，(Wang 等, 2024) 报告在一系列逆问题上相对最先进基线取得 2–6 dB 的 PSNR 提升，尽管只用了 3 步 DDIM 先验 (Song 等, 2021)。同样，(Jalal 等, 2021) 表明，一个仅在二维脑部 MRI 上训练的扩散先验，仍可用于重建膝关节、腹部 MRI 等分布之外的扫描。

English original
Surprisingly, these weak priors can still yield highly competitive reconstructions. For example, (Wang et al., 2024) reports a 222–666 dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art baselines across a range of inverse problems, despite using only a 333-step DDIM prior (Song et al., 2021). Likewise, (Jalal et al., 2021) shows that a diffusion prior trained exclusively on 2D brain MRI can still be used to reconstruct out-of-distribution scans such as knee and abdomen MRI.

这些结果引出一个谜题：标准直觉认为重建质量受先验质量约束。然而在这些情形下，弱先验的表现几乎与更强的先验一样好，甚至更好。目前，这类成功大多以个案形式出现在应用驱动的研究中，对弱先验何时以及为何足够，仍缺乏系统理解。

English original
These results raise a puzzle: standard intuition suggests that the quality of the reconstruction is bounded by the quality of the prior. Yet, in these regimes, weak priors perform nearly as well as, or even better than, stronger ones. At present, such successes are largely reported case by case in application-driven studies, and a systematic understanding of when and why weak priors suffice remains lacking.

受这些观察启发，我们追问：一个低保真的卧室扩散模型能否恢复人脸图像？更广泛地说，我们研究逆问题何时对先验的选择具有鲁棒性——即低质量或不匹配的生成先验仍能给出高质量重建——以及何时不能。

English original
Motivated by these observations, we ask: can a low-fidelity bedroom diffusion model recover face images? More broadly, we study when an inverse problem is robust to the choice of prior, in the sense that a low-quality or mismatched generative prior can still yield high-quality reconstructions, and when it cannot.

我们的主要贡献是对这一现象给出严格刻画，并以实验、理论分析和局部相关性诊断作为支撑。我们的核心信息是：弱先验可以在数据信息量充足的情形下表现强劲。这来自两个相关效应。第一，数据可以压过先验：当测量的有效维数很大时，重建更多由观测而非先验驱动。第二，弱先验并不像它们的样本所显示的那样弱：即使是少步数或域外的自然图像先验，也可以与更强的匹配先验共享局部空间相关性。这两个效应共同提供了一个互补解释：信息量充足的测量提供局部锚点，而先验通过共享的局部空间结构把这些约束传播开。

English original
Our main contribution is a rigorous characterization of this phenomenon, supported by empirical experiments, theoretical analysis, and local-correlation diagnostics. Our central message is that weak priors can perform strongly in data-informative regimes. This happens because of two related effects. First, data can dominate the prior: when the measurement has large effective dimension, reconstruction is driven more by the observation than by prior. Second, weak priors are not as weak as their samples suggest: even few-step or out-of-domain natural-image priors can share local spatial correlations with stronger matched priors. These two effects together provide a complementary explanation: informative measurements supply local anchors, while the prior propagates these constraints through shared local spatial structure.

在概念上，我们的结果表明：当测量足够有信息量时，先验的重要性可能低于通常假设——一个强的、域匹配先验的价值取决于测量的信息量。在实践上，这支持在缺乏强域匹配先验、但数据信息量充足的情形下，把弱先验作为合理默认；而在重建更依赖先验的低信息量情形下，保留更强的匹配先验。为支撑上述结论，我们提供：

English original
Conceptually, our results show that the prior may matter less than is often assumed when measurements are sufficiently informative: the value of a strong, domain-matched prior depends on measurement informativeness. Practically, this supports using weak priors as a reasonable default in data-informative regimes where strong, domain-matched priors are unavailable, while reserving stronger matched priors for low-information settings where reconstruction is more prior-dependent. To support this, we provide:
  1. 经验证据：我们跨逆问题、数据集和扩散骨干网络开展了大量实验。我们发现，即使是严重截断或不匹配的先验，在数据信息量充足的情形下也能给出准确的重建。
  2. 机制解释：我们把贝叶斯一致性理论与局部空间相关性诊断结合起来，解释弱先验为何有效。理论把测量的信息量与先验敏感度的降低联系起来：当有效观测维数很大、且信号可由测量辨识时，后验集中在与测量一致的最佳众数附近，先验权重的影响被削弱。空间诊断显示，弱先验与更强的自然图像先验可以共享几乎相同的局部相关性衰减曲线，说明即使不匹配的先验，在测量提供足够锚点后也能提供有用的局部结构信息。
  3. 失败模式：除成功案例外，我们还研究弱先验何时失败。这些情形包括盒状修补和大尺度超分辨率——观测留下大片缺失区域，或有效观测维数很小。在这些情形下重建更依赖先验，弱先验或不匹配先验可能产生不一致的结构。我们用理论与实验共同支撑这些发现。
  4. 算法改进：为实现分析所预测的先验鲁棒行为，我们用新的优化器和改进的早停规则改进初始噪声优化，从而稳定重建并减少过拟合。
English original
  • Empirical evidence: We conduct extensive experiments across inverse problems, datasets, and diffusion backbones. We find that even severely truncated or mismatched priors can yield accurate reconstructions in data-informative regimes.
  • Mechanistic explanation: We combine Bayesian-consistency theory with local spatial-correlation diagnostics to explain why weak priors can work. The theory links measurement informativeness to reduced prior sensitivity: when the effective observed dimension is large and the signal is identifiable from the measurements, the posterior concentrates near the best measurement-consistent mode and the influence of the prior weights is reduced. The spatial diagnostics show that weak and stronger natural-image priors can share nearly identical local-correlation decay curves, suggesting that even mismatched priors can provide useful local structural information once the measurements supply enough anchors.
  • Failure modes: Beyond the successful cases, we study when weak priors fail. These include box inpainting and large-scale super-resolution, where the observation leaves a large missing region or a small effective observed dimension. In these regimes, reconstruction becomes more prior-dependent, and weak or mismatched priors can produce inconsistent structures. We support these findings with both theory and experiments.
  • Algorithmic refinements: To realize the prior-robust behavior predicted by our analysis, we refine initial-noise optimization with a new optimizer and an improved early-stopping rule, which stabilize reconstruction and reduce overfitting.

    • 2 弱扩散生成器作为先验

    English original
    2 Weak diffusion generators as priors

    2.1 设定与我们的算法

    English original
    2.1 Setup and our algorithm

    问题表述：我们研究形如 y=A(x)+ϵy = \mathcal{A}(x) + \epsilony=A(x)+ϵ 的逆问题，其中 y∈Rmy \in \mathbb{R}^my∈Rm 表示观测数据，x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^nx∈Rn 是待重建的未知信号。映射 A:Rn→Rm\mathcal{A}:\mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^mA:Rn→Rm 称为前向算子，ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im)\epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m)ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​) 建模加性高斯噪声。

    English original
    Formulation: We study inverse problems of the form y  =  A(x)+ϵ,y \;=\; \mathcal{A}(x) + \epsilon,y=A(x)+ϵ, where y∈Rmy \in \mathbb{R}^my∈Rm denotes the observed data and x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^nx∈Rn is the unknown signal to be reconstructed. The map A:Rn→Rm\mathcal{A}:\mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^mA:Rn→Rm is called the forward operator, and ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im)\epsilon \sim \mathbb{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m)ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​) models additive Gaussian noise.

    扩散先验：从 xxx 到 yyy 的映射通常是多对一的，因此由 yyy 恢复 xxx 是不适定的。为对问题做正则化，我们在 xxx 上放置一个先验分布 π\piπ，以刻画合理信号（如自然图像）的结构。在现代生成建模中，这种先验常由一个预训练生成器 GGG 指定，它把高斯噪声映射到数据空间中的样本。本文关注基于扩散的生成器，其中 GGG 由有限步反向扩散实现（例如 kkk 步 DDIM 采样器）。

    English original
    Diffusion prior: The mapping from xxx to yyy is typically many-to-one, so recovering xxx from yyy is ill-posed. To regularize the problem, we place a prior distribution π\piπ on xxx that captures the structure of plausible signals (e.g., natural images). In modern generative modeling, such a prior is often specified through a pretrained generator GGG that maps Gaussian noise to a sample in data space. In this paper, we focus on diffusion-based generators, where GGG is realized by a finite number of reverse diffusion steps (e.g., a kkk-step DDIM sampler).

    两个轴上的弱先验：多数已有工作使用强且匹配的扩散先验：高质量扩散采样器（常使用完整的长反向链），且训练分布与目标信号高度匹配。本文把缺少其中一项或两项性质的先验称为弱先验。因此，弱扩散先验可以沿两个独立的轴出现：

    English original
    Weak prior in two axes: Most prior work uses a strong and matched diffusion prior: a high-quality diffusion sampler, often using the original long reverse chain, trained on a distribution that closely matches the target signals. In this paper, we call a prior weak if it lacks one or both of these properties. Thus, weak diffusion priors can arise along two independent axes:
    • 生成器质量：GGG 只运行少数反向步（例如 1–4 步 DDIM 采样器）得到，通常产生低保真的无条件样本。
    • 域匹配：GGG 训练所用的源分布不同于信号的目分布。
    English original
  • Generator quality: GGG is obtained by running only a few reverse steps (e.g., a 1–4 step DDIM sampler), which typically yields low-fidelity unconditional samples.
  • Domain match: GGG is trained on a source distribution different from the target distribution of the signal.

    • 例如，在恢复人脸的任务中，一个在人脸图像上训练的 3 步 DDIM 生成器沿生成器质量轴是弱的：它与目标域匹配，但无条件样本低保真（见图 1 左上图）。一个在卧室图像上训练的 3 步 DDIM 生成器在两个轴上都弱：质量低，且与目标分布不匹配（见图 1 左下图）。类似地，若用完整的卧室训练扩散模型去恢复人脸，即使其无条件卧室样本质量很高，它在域匹配轴上也是弱的。

    English original
    For example, in a task of recovering human faces, a 333-step DDIM generator trained on face images is weak along the generator-quality axis: it is matched to the target domain, but its unconditional samples are low-fidelity (see the top-left image in Figure 1). A 333-step DDIM generator trained on bedroom images is weak along both axes: it is low-quality and also mismatched to the target distribution (see the bottom-left image in Figure 1). Similarly, a full bedroom-trained diffusion model used to recover faces would be weak along the domain-match axis, even if its unconditional bedroom samples are high quality.

    我们的主要实验集中在这些少步匹配与少步不匹配、并使用初始噪声优化的设定；在附录 C.9 中，我们进一步把域不匹配的影响与逆问题求解器的选择分离开来。

This adjustment has been implemented in many ways, such as guidance, variable splitting, and sequential Monte Carlo; see (Zheng et al., 2025) for a summary. Among them, diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) (Chung et al., 2023) is one of the most popular solvers, so we take it as our baseline.

    初始噪声优化：另一条工作线把生成模型 GGG 视为黑盒生成器，通过优化隐变量输入来求解逆问题。给定观测 yyy，它计算

    公式 (1)
    arg⁡min⁡zL(A(G(z)),y)+λR(G(z)),\arg\min_z L\left(\mathcal{A}(G(z)), y\right)+ \lambda\mathcal{R}(G(z)),argzmin​L(A(G(z)),y)+λR(G(z)),

    其中 LLL 度量模拟测量 A(G(z))\mathcal{A}(G(z))A(G(z)) 与 yyy 之间的失配，R\mathcal{R}R 是正则项。

    where LLL measures the mismatch between the simulated measurement A(G(z))\mathcal{A}(G(z))A(G(z)) and yyy, and R\mathcal{R}R is a regularizer.

    这种隐变量优化的视角在概念上很简单，可追溯到关于 GAN 与 VAE 的工作 (Bora 等, 2017)。然而当 GGG 是完整扩散模型时，优化式 (1) 需要在数十到数百个采样步上反向传播，显存与计算代价往往过高。因此已有工作不得不使用非常弱的生成器 GGG（例如 1–4 步 DDIM 采样器）(Wang 等, 2024)、(Chihaoui 等, 2024)。令人惊讶的是，这种基于弱生成器的逆问题求解器可以超过完整扩散步修改类方法，这正是本研究的动机。

    English original
    This latent-optimization view is conceptually simple and dates back to work on GANs and VAEs (Bora et al., 2017). However, when GGG is a full diffusion model, optimizing Eq. (1) requires backpropagating through tens to hundreds of sampling steps, which is often too costly in memory and compute. As a result, prior work has to use a very weak generator GGG (e.g., a 1–4 step DDIM sampler) (Wang et al., 2024); (Chihaoui et al., 2024). Surprisingly, such inverse problem solvers based on weak generators can outperform full diffusion step-modification methods, which motivates our study.

    除逆问题任务之外，初始噪声技术近来因其支撑推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）的潜力而在多类应用中受到关注；见 (Ben-Hamu 等, 2024)、(Jia 等, 2026)、(Ma 等, 2025)、(Zhou 等, 2025)、(Wan 等, 2025)、(Tang 等, 2025)。

    English original

    AdamSphere 与 HoldoutTopK 早停：集中性与过拟合这两个因素会影响式 (1) 的解质量。第一，扩散模型训练时取 z∼N(0,Id)z\sim \mathcal{N}(0,I_d)z∼N(0,Id​)，其质量在高维下集中于球面 ∥z∥≈d\|z\|\approx \sqrt{d}∥z∥≈d​ 附近 (Vershynin, 2018)。无约束优化可能把 zzz 推离这一典型壳层，降低重建质量。因此我们提出 AdamSphere，一种修改的 Adam 优化器，在整个过程中把 zzz 保持在球面上。第二，已有观察 (Wang 等, 2024) 表明隐变量优化会过拟合测量噪声。我们提出 HoldoutTopK 早停。我们留出一部分测量（不用于优化），并在每次迭代追踪其损失；随后在留出损失最好的 KKK 个迭代里返回最新的一次。我们的想法受统计机器学习启发：那里用验证集近似测试性能并指导模型选择。但与机器学习中通常只选验证误差最小的单一候选不同，我们保留前 KKK 名并返回其中最新的迭代。我们发现 K>1K>1K>1 可降低对噪声波动的敏感性，同时仍选到能在留出集上泛化的近最优检查点。

    English original
    AdamSphere and HoldoutTopK early stopping: Two factors, concentration and overfitting, affect the solution quality of Eq. (1). First, diffusion models are trained with z∼N(0,Id)z\sim \mathbb{N}(0,I_d)z∼N(0,Id​), whose mass in high dimension concentrates near the sphere ∥z∥≈d\|z\|\approx \sqrt{d}∥z∥≈d​ (Vershynin, 2018). Unconstrained optimization can push zzz off this typical shell and degrade reconstruction quality. We therefore propose AdamSphere, a modified Adam optimizer that keeps zzz on the sphere throughout. Second, it has been observed (Wang et al., 2024) that latent optimization can overfit measurement noise. We propose HoldoutTopK early stopping. We hold out a subset of measurements (not used in optimization) and track its loss at each iteration. We then return the latest iterate among the best KKK holdout losses. Our idea is inspired by statistical machine learning, where a validation set is used to approximate test performance and guide model selection. However, unlike the usual practice in machine learning of selecting the single lowest-validation-error candidate, we keep the top-KKK and return the latest iterate among them. We find that K>1K>1K>1 reduces sensitivity to noisy fluctuations while still selecting a near-best checkpoint that generalizes to the holdout set.

    由于 AdamSphere 已把迭代点约束在球面上，我们只优化均方误差（MSE）：

    English original
    Since AdamSphere already constrains the iterates to lie on the sphere, we optimize only the mean-squared error (MSE):
    公式 (2)
    arg⁡min⁡z∥A(G(z))−y∥2.\arg\min_z \left\lVert \mathcal{A}(G(z)) - y \right\rVert^2 .argzmin​∥A(G(z))−y∥2.

    2.2 主要观察

    English original
    2.2 Main observations

    我们的主要观察是：弱扩散生成器在许多实际逆问题上仍能带来强劲表现。图 1 给出代表性例子。左面板展示对人脸做修补（inpainting）的任务，使用两种不同的弱先验；观测图像（测量）通过遮住很大一部分像素、并对其余像素加高斯噪声得到。参考列显示干净图像，但重建算法从不使用它。两行都使用 3 步 DDIM 先验：上（左面板的顶行）的先验在人脸图像上训练，下行的先验在卧室图像上训练。我们用第 2.1 节的初始噪声优化过程重建含噪图像，并展示优化迭代 1、5、10、100、1000 步的中间重建。特别地，Iteration 1 对应尚未做任何优化时的无条件 3 步 DDIM 样本。

    English original
    Our main observation is that weak diffusion generators can still deliver strong performance on many practical inverse problems. Figure 1 shows representative examples. The left panel illustrates an inpainting task on a human face using two different weak priors, where the observed image (measurement) is obtained by masking a large fraction of pixels and adding Gaussian noise to the remaining pixels. The reference column shows the clean image, but it is never used by the reconstruction algorithm. Both rows use a 3-step DDIM prior: the prior in the top row (in the left panel) is trained on human face images, while the prior in the bottom row is trained on bedroom images. We reconstruct the noisy image using the initial-noise optimization procedure in Section 2.1, and show intermediate reconstructions at optimization iterations 1,5,10,100,1, 5, 10, 100,1,5,10,100, and 100010001000. In particular, Iteration 1 corresponds to the unconditional 3-step DDIM sample, before any optimization is performed.

    两行的先验都是「弱」的。在顶行，先验是域内但质量低：无条件样本捕捉到脸的粗略轮廓，但大部分颜色与细节缺失。底行使用更弱的域外先验：无条件样本是一张低保真的卧室草图。然而随着优化进行，两种先验都迅速拟合测量，收敛到视觉上相似且准确的重建。在卧室训练的模型下，轨迹尤其引人注目：早期迭代看起来像带直边和盒状结构的卧室场景；但随着优化推进，这些特征淡去，图像逐渐变成人脸，轮廓更平滑、细节更多。这明确回答了本文开头的问题：即使在卧室上训练的低保真扩散模型，也能恢复人脸图像。

    English original
    The priors in both rows are “weak.” In the top row, the prior is in-distribution but low quality: the unconditional sample captures the rough outline of a face, but most colors and finer details are missing. The bottom row uses an even weaker, out-of-distribution prior: the unconditional sample is a low-quality sketch of a bedroom image. Nevertheless, as optimization proceeds, both priors quickly fit the measurement and converge to reconstructions that are both visually similar and accurate. The trajectory under the bedroom-trained prior is especially striking: early iterates look like a bedroom scene with straight edges and box-like shapes; but as optimization goes on, these features fade and the image gradually turns into a human face, with smoother contours and more detail. This firmly answers the question at the beginning of our paper: even a low-fidelity diffusion model trained on bedrooms can recover face images.

    图 1 的右面板展示了一个超分辨率实验，结论类似。这些例子只是我们研究的一小部分。在第 4.1 节，我们给出跨多个任务、更大规模的评估，把弱先验与强先验基线比较。总体而言，结果表明弱扩散先验在数据信息量充足的情形下可以匹配强先验基线。

    English original
    The right panel of Figure 1 shows a super-resolution experiment with similar conclusions. These examples are only a small sample of our study. In Section 4.1, we present larger-scale evaluations across multiple tasks, comparing weak priors against strong-prior baselines. Overall, the results suggest that weak diffusion priors can match strong-prior baselines in data-informative regimes.

    3 弱先验为何有效

    English original
    3 Why weak priors can work

    我们现在研究弱扩散先验为何仍能带来准确重建。我们识别出两个互补机制。第一，当测量信息量足够时，观测可以压过先验：不同先验可以导致相似的后验，因为后验集中在同一个与测量一致的信号附近。第 3.1 与 3.2 节通过贝叶斯一致性论证和高维高斯混合代理模型把这一效应形式化。第二，弱先验并非任意：即使少步数或域不匹配的自然图像先验，也能与更强的匹配先验共享局部空间统计。第 3.3 节给出支持第二个机制的局部相关性诊断。在介绍这两个机制之后，我们在第 3.4 节讨论它们何时失效。

    English original
    We now study why weak diffusion priors can still lead to accurate reconstructions. We identify two complementary mechanisms. First, when the measurement is sufficiently informative, the observation can dominate the prior: different priors can lead to similar posteriors because the posterior concentrates near the same measurement-consistent signal. Sections 3.1 and 3.2 formalize this effect through Bayesian-consistency arguments and a high-dimensional Gaussian-mixture surrogate. Second, weak priors are not arbitrary: even few-step or domain-mismatched natural-image priors can share local spatial statistics with stronger matched priors. Section 3.3 provides a local-correlation diagnostic supporting this second mechanism. After presenting these two mechanisms, we discuss when they break down in Section 3.4.

    3.1 独立同分布数据下的后验一致性

    English original
    3.1 Posterior consistency under i.i.d. data

    我们首先回顾贝叶斯推断中的一个标准现象：在独立同分布（i.i.d.）模型下，信息量足够的数据可以压过先验。考虑线性逆问题 y=Ax+ϵy = Ax + \epsilony=Ax+ϵ，其中 ϵ\epsilonϵ 是标准高斯噪声。在一个合成实验中，我们固定真值信号 x⋆x^\starx⋆，抽取线性算子 AAA，并生成 i.i.d. 观测 y1:Ny_{1:N}y1:N​。然后我们在 xxx 上放置两个彼此分离的高斯混合先验 πA\pi_AπA​ 与 πB\pi_BπB​（图 2 左面板）。尽管差异很大，随着 NNN 增大，两个后验 πA(⋅∣y1:N)\pi_A(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})πA​(⋅∣y1:N​) 与 πB(⋅∣y1:N)\pi_B(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})πB​(⋅∣y1:N​) 都集中在 x⋆x^\starx⋆ 附近，如图 2 右侧两面板所示。

    English original
    We first recall a standard phenomenon in Bayesian inference: under an i.i.d.\ model, sufficiently informative data can dominate the prior. Consider the linear inverse problem y=Ax+ϵ,y = Ax + \epsilon,y=Ax+ϵ, where ϵ\epsilonϵ is the standard Gaussian noise. In a synthetic experiment, we fix a ground-truth signal x⋆x^\starx⋆, draw a linear operator AAA, and generate i.i.d.\ observations y1:Ny_{1:N}y1:N​. We then place two well-separated Gaussian-mixture priors πA\pi_AπA​ and πB\pi_BπB​ on xxx (Figure 2 left panel). Despite their large difference, as NNN increases both posteriors πA(⋅∣y1:N)\pi_A(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})πA​(⋅∣y1:N​) and πB(⋅∣y1:N)\pi_B(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})πB​(⋅∣y1:N​) concentrate around x⋆x^\starx⋆, as shown in the right two panels of Figure 2.

    这是后验一致性的一个实例。粗略地说，后验由先验和数据共同决定。当数据信息量越来越大（这里样本量增大）时，似然项最终会压过先验。因此，即使先验非常不同，所得后验仍可同时集中在同一真值信号上。(Schwartz, 1965) 的经典结果精确刻画了这一点。为便于阅读，假设与确切的收敛概念推迟到附录 A.1。

    English original
    This is an instance of posterior consistency. At a high level, the posterior is determined by both the prior and the data. As the data become increasingly informative (here, as the sample size grows), the likelihood term ultimately overwhelms the prior. Thus, even when the priors are very different, the resulting posteriors can still both concentrate on the same ground-truth signal. A classical result due to (Schwartz, 1965) makes this precise. For readability, assumptions and the exact convergence notion are deferred to the Appendix A.1.

    定理 1

    设 {Px}x∈X\{P_x\}_{x\in\mathcal X}{Px​}x∈X​ 为统计模型，Y1,Y2,…Y_1,Y_2,\ldotsY1​,Y2​,… 为来自 Px⋆P_{x^\star}Px⋆​ 的 i.i.d. 样本。在标准正则性与可辨识性假设下，并假设先验 π\piπ 在 x⋆x^\starx⋆ 的每个邻域都赋予正质量，则当 N→∞N\to\inftyN→∞ 时后验 π(⋅∣y1:N)\pi(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})π(⋅∣y1:N​) 集中在 x⋆x^\starx⋆。
    English original
    Let {Px}x∈X\{P_x\}_{x\in\mathcal X}{Px​}x∈X​ be a statistical model and let Y1,Y2,…Y_1,Y_2,\ldotsY1​,Y2​,… be i.i.d.\ from Px⋆P_{x^\star}Px⋆​. Under standard regularity and identifiability assumptions, and assuming the prior π\piπ puts positive mass in every neighborhood of x⋆x^\starx⋆, the posterior π(⋅∣y1:N)\pi(\cdot\mid y_{1:N})π(⋅∣y1:N​) concentrates at x⋆x^\starx⋆ as N→∞N\to\inftyN→∞.

    定理 1 表明，在 i.i.d. 模型下，随着样本量增大，先验的影响变得可忽略。这一结论很有启发性，但 i.i.d. 设定不同于图像逆问题：那里测量（像素）强相关，且通常只有一个观测 y⋆y^\stary⋆。下一节发展理论，研究高维、单观测情形下的后验行为。

    English original
    Theorem 1 shows that, under the i.i.d. model, the effect of the prior becomes negligible as the sample size grows. While insightful, the i.i.d.\ setting differs from image inverse problems, where measurements (pixels) are strongly dependent and we typically have only a single observation y⋆y^\stary⋆. The next section develops theory to study the posterior behavior in high-dimensional, single-observation regime.

    3.2 高维逆问题中的数据主导

    English original
    3.2 Data dominance in high-dimensional inverse problems

    我们继续研究线性逆问题 y=Ax+ϵy = Ax + \epsilony=Ax+ϵ，其中 x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^nx∈Rn，A∈Rm×nA \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n，ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im)\epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m)ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​)。全文关注具有实际意义的区间：只有单个观测 y⋆y^\stary⋆ 可用（例如一张受损图像），而测量维数 mmm 很大（例如 512×512×3512\times512\times 3512×512×3）。我们的目标是理解后验何时对生成先验的选择鲁棒，从而差别很大的先验仍能给出相似的重建。

    We continue to study the linear inverse problem y=Ax+ϵ,y = Ax + \epsilon,y=Ax+ϵ, where x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^nx∈Rn, A∈Rm×nA \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n, and ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im)\epsilon \sim \mathbb{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m)ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​). Our goal is to understand when the posterior is robust to the choice of generative prior, so that substantially different priors can still yield similar reconstructions.

    本节中，我们用 φ(⋅,μ,Σ)\varphi(\cdot, \mu, \Sigma)φ(⋅,μ,Σ) 表示 N(μ,Σ)\mathcal{N}(\mu, \Sigma)N(μ,Σ) 的密度。

    English original
    Throughout this section, we use φ(⋅,μ,Σ)\varphi(\cdot, \mu, \Sigma)φ(⋅,μ,Σ) to denote the density of N(μ,Σ)\mathbb{N}(\mu, \Sigma)N(μ,Σ).

    生成先验的可处理模型。诸如 kkk 步 DDIM 的现代生成先验没有可处理的密度。但在实践中，其样本倾向于落在数据流形附近，即生成的图像常常接近合理的干净图像原型。受此启发，一种常见的代理是把先验建模为高斯混合。有限高斯混合模型可以任意好地逼近一大类分布 (McLachlan 与 Peel, 2000)，因此在扩散模型研究中被广泛采用，见 (Shah 等, 2023)、(Wu 等, 2024)、(Gatmiry 等, 2025)、(Liang 等, 2025)。特别地，我们假设先验是各向同性高斯混合

    English original
    A tractable model for generative priors. Modern generative priors such as kkk-step DDIM do not admit a tractable density. However, in practice their samples tend to lie near the data manifold, in the sense that generated images are often close to plausible clean-image prototypes. Motivated by this, a common surrogate is to model the prior as a Gaussian mixture. Finite Gaussian mixture models can approximate a broad class of distributions arbitrarily well (McLachlan & Peel, 2000). They are therefore widely adopted in studies of diffusion models, see (Shah et al., 2023); (Wu et al., 2024); (Gatmiry et al., 2025); (Liang et al., 2025). In particular, we assume the prior is an isotropic Gaussian mixture

    English original
    Interpretation. Theorem 3 shows that if the best-matching component is δ0\delta_0δ0​-identifiable, then the posterior concentrates overwhelmingly on this component, with the remaining mass decaying exponentially in dimension mmm. A simple intuition for Assumption 2 is: in image inverse problems like random inpainting, once many pixels are observed, incorrect candidate images often disagree with the observation in many places (edges, textures, colors), so the best-matching candidate becomes clearly separated.

    值得注意的是，定理 3 在很大程度上不依赖于具体的生成先验选择：只要混合权重在常数倍以内有界，先验只通过常数影响该界。因此，在数据信息量充足的区间（即假设 2 成立）且观测高维（mmm 大）时，差别极大的先验仍能给出相似的重建，后验集中在同一个众数上。

Therefore, in the data-informative regime (i.e., when Assumption 2 holds) and with high-dimensional observations (large mmm), very different priors can still yield similar reconstructions, with the posterior concentrating on the same mode.

    为可辨识假设提供依据。我们用理论和经验结果共同为 δ0\delta_0δ0​-可辨识假设提供依据。我们评估三个数据集：CelebA、Church 与 Bedroom。对每张图像（像素值归一化到 (−1,1)(-1,1)(−1,1)），我们通过遮住 70% 像素并给其余像素加高斯噪声，生成一个修补观测。对每个产生的观测，我们对数据集中每张图像施加相同的前向掩膜，并计算观测像素上的 MSE（正比于分数）。随后对每张图像计算每维 MSE 间隔，并在表 1 中报告汇总的间隔统计。

    Justifying the identifiable assumption. We justify the δ0\delta_0δ0​-identifiable assumption using both theory and empirical results. We evaluate three datasets: CelebA, Church, and Bedroom. For each image (with pixel values normalized to (−1,1)(-1,1)(−1,1)), we generate an inpainting observation by masking 70%70\%70% of pixels and adding Gaussian noise to the remaining pixels. For each resulting observation, we apply the same forward mask to every image in the dataset and compute the MSE on the observed pixels (which is proportional to the score). We then compute the per-dimension MSE gap for each image and report aggregated gap statistics in Table 1.

    这些结果表明存在清晰分离：平均每维间隔约为 0.22–0.28。把它解释为逐像素平方差，对应观测项上的平均绝对差至少为 0.22≈0.47\sqrt{0.22}\approx 0.470.22​≈0.47；由于每个像素位于 [−1,1][-1,1][−1,1]（范围为 2），这是相当大的失配。此外，即使在最坏情况下间隔也远离零：所有图像上最小的每维 MSE 间隔至少为 0.09（平均绝对差至少 0.3）。因此，这些结果说明最佳匹配候选通常与次优候选分离良好。在附录 A.4 中，我们用集中不等式为假设 2 提供理论依据。

    English original

Moreover, the gap stays bounded away from zero even in the worst case: the minimum per-dimension MSE gap over all images is at least 0.090.090.09 (average absolute difference of at least 0.30.30.3). Thus, these suggest that the best-matching candidate is typically well separated from the runner-up. In Appendix A.4, we provide a theoretical justification for Assumption 2 using concentration inequalities.

    3.3 弱先验与更强先验共享的局部结构

    English original
    3.3 Shared local structure in weak and stronger priors

    上面的后验集中结果解释了现象的一面：信息量充足的测量可以降低对先验的敏感度。它留下第二个问题：`弱先验' 真的弱吗？也就是说，即使样本低保真或不匹配，它们是否仍保留有助于重建的有用结构信息？

    English original
    The posterior-concentration result above explains one side of the phenomenon: informative measurements can reduce sensitivity to the prior. It leaves open a second question: are `weak priors' truly weak? That is, even when their samples are low-fidelity or mismatched, do they still preserve useful structural information that helps reconstruction?

    我们用一个简单的诊断回答这个问题：无条件样本的空间自相关曲线。它度量像素值随空间距离增大而失去相关的速度，因而刻画生成图像中的短程局部结构信息。

    English original
    We answer this question through a simple diagnostic: the spatial autocorrelation profile of unconditional samples. It measures how quickly pixel values decorrelate as spatial distance increases, and therefore captures short-range local structural information in the generated images.

    我们比较在 CelebA-HQ 与 LSUN Bedroom 上训练的扩散先验，采样分别使用 3 或 20 个 DDIM 步。对每个「模型–采样器」组合，我们计算其样本的空间自相关曲线；完整定义与实现细节见附录 C.8。

    English original
    We compare diffusion priors trained on CelebA-HQ and LSUN Bedroom, sampled with either 3 or 20 DDIM steps. For each model–sampler pair, we compute the spatial autocorrelation profile of their samples; the full definition and implementation details are given in Appendix C.8.

    表 2 报告代表性滞后。主要规律是：自相关曲线在两个变化轴（采样器强度与训练域）上都高度相似。特别地，从 20 步 DDIM 改为 3 步 DDIM 会大幅降低无条件样本保真度，从 CelebA-HQ 换到 LSUN Bedroom 会改变先验的语义内容。然而四条曲线都随距离呈现相似的衰减。例如，3 步 Bedroom 曲线与 20 步 CelebA-HQ 曲线在滞后 1,…,321,\ldots,321,…,32 上的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.9987。这说明弱先验可以失去样本保真度或域匹配，却仍保留相似的短程局部结构信息。

    English original
    Table 2 reports representative lags. The main pattern is that the autocorrelation profiles are highly similar across both axes of variation: sampler strength and training domain. In particular, changing from 20 DDIM steps to 3 DDIM steps greatly reduces unconditional sample fidelity, and changing from CelebA-HQ to LSUN Bedroom changes the semantic content of the prior. Nevertheless, all four profiles show a similar decay with distance. For example, the Pearson correlation between the 3-step Bedroom profile and the 20-step CelebA-HQ profile over lags 1,…,321,\ldots,321,…,32 is 0.99870.99870.9987. This suggests that weak priors can lose sample fidelity or domain match while still preserving similar short-range local structural information.

    机制解释：与定理 3 一起，这为弱先验为何有效提供了互补解释。信息量充足的测量通过固定或强约束大量像素提供局部锚点，而先验帮助把这些约束传播到附近未观测或受损的像素。由于弱先验与更强的自然图像先验共享相似的短程局部相关性，即使弱先验也能为这种传播提供有用的局部结构信息。因此，弱先验可以是差的无条件生成器，但当测量提供足够锚点时，仍能充当有用的条件先验。

    English original
    Mechanistic explanation: Together with Theorem 3, this gives a complementary explanation for why weak priors can work. Informative measurements provide local anchors by fixing or strongly constraining many pixels, while the prior helps propagate these constraints to nearby unobserved or corrupted pixels. Because weak and stronger natural-image priors share similar short-range local correlations, even a weak prior can provide useful local structural information for this propagation. Thus, weak priors can be poor unconditional generators while still serving as useful conditional priors when the measurement provides enough anchors.

    3.4 弱先验何时失败

    English original
    3.4 When weak priors fail

    上述两个机制也澄清了弱扩散先验何时失败。第一，当观测不能辨识出唯一与测量一致的信号时，数据主导会失效。例如在大面积盒状修补中，算子 AAA 移除一块连续区域。许多图像可以匹配观测像素，却在缺失盒内部不同，于是假设 2 中的每维分数间隔可能非常小。此时后验不必集中在单一众数上，重建变得由先验主导。第二，当任务需要全局语义生成时，局部结构信息不够。在盒状修补中，缺失区域必须用测量中基本不存在的信息来填充。不匹配的先验可能传播了局部统计，却生成与目标图像不一致的语义内容。

    English original
    The two mechanisms above also clarify when weak diffusion priors fail. First, data dominance can break down when the observation does not identify a unique measurement-consistent signal. In large box inpainting, for example, the operator AAA removes a contiguous region. Many images can match the observed pixels while differing inside the missing box, so the per-dimension score gap in Assumption 2 can be very small. The posterior then need not concentrate on a single mode, and reconstruction becomes prior-dominated. Second, local structural information is not enough when the task requires global semantic generation. In box inpainting, the missing region must be filled using information that is largely absent from the measurement. A mismatched prior may then propagate local statistics but still generate semantic content inconsistent with the target image.

    当有效测量维数很小时会出现类似问题。定理 3 的界包含因子 Mexp⁡(−δ0m)M\exp(-\delta_0 m)Mexp(−δ0​m)：它随候选众数个数 MMM 线性增长，并随观测测量数 mmm 指数衰减。对 256×256256\times256256×256 RGB 图像的 70% 随机修补，m≈256×256×30%×3≈60,000m\approx 256\times256\times 30\%\times 3\approx 60{,}000m≈256×256×30%×3≈60,000，指数项可以占主导。然而对 16 倍超分辨率，mmm 可低至 16×16×3=76816\times16\times3=76816×16×3=768。在这种低信息量区间，测量提供的锚点太少，重建对先验强度与域匹配的敏感度大大增加。我们在第 4.3 节用实验验证这些失败模式。

    English original
    A similar issue appears when the effective measurement dimension is small. The bound in Theorem 3 contains the factor Mexp⁡(−δ0m)M\exp(-\delta_0 m)Mexp(−δ0​m): it grows linearly with the number of candidate modes MMM and decays exponentially in the number of observed measurements mmm. For 70%70\%70% random inpainting on a 256×256256\times256256×256 RGB image, m≈256×256×30%×3≈60,000m\approx 256\times256\times 30\%\times 3\approx 60{,}000m≈256×256×30%×3≈60,000, so the exponential term can dominate. For 16×16\times16× super-resolution, however, mmm can be as low as 16×16×3=76816\times16\times3=76816×16×3=768. In such low-information regimes, the measurement provides too few anchors, so reconstruction becomes much more sensitive to the strength and domain match of the prior. We empirically validate these failure modes in Section 4.3.

    4 实验

    English original
    4 Experiments

    我们在四个任务上评估方法：修补、高斯去模糊、超分辨率，以及带加性高斯噪声的非线性去模糊。每一小节报告与该设定最相关的任务子集，完整结果见附录 C。与 DAPS (Zhang 等, 2025)、DiffPIR (Zhu 等, 2023)、Deep Random Projector 以及科学逆问题的额外比较见附录 C.3、C.4 与 C.5。我们在附录 C.10 研究对测量噪声的敏感性。我们用标准指标评估每种方法，例如 PSNR、SSIM 与 LPIPS (Zhang 等, 2018)。

    English original
    We evaluate our method on four tasks: inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, super-resolution, and nonlinear deblurring with additive Gaussian noise. For each subsection, we report the subset of tasks most relevant to the setting under study, while full results across are provided in Appendix C. Additional comparisons with DAPS (Zhang et al., 2025) and DiffPIR (Zhu et al., 2023), Deep Random Projector, and scientific inverse-problems are provided in Appendices C.3, C.4, and C.5. We study sensitivity to measurement noise in Appendix C.10. We evaluate each method using standard metrics, e.g. PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018).

    除非另有说明，所有实验都使用公开可用的预训练扩散检查点，对应 Bedroom（LSUN-Bedroom (Yu 等, 2015)）、Church（LSUN-Church (Yu 等, 2015)）与人脸（CelebA-HQ (Liu 等, 2015)）数据集。每个设定随机选取 100 张测试图像评估；消融实验使用 50 张的缩减集。详细实验设置见附录 C.12。附录 D 提供更多可视化。

    English original
    Unless otherwise stated, all experiments are conducted using publicly available pretrained diffusion checkpoints for the Bedroom (LSUN-Bedroom (Yu et al., 2015)), Church (LSUN-Church (Yu et al., 2015)), and Human face (CelebA-HQ (Liu et al., 2015)) datasets. For each setting, we randomly select 100 test images for evaluation. For the ablation studies, we use a reduced set of 50 images. Detailed experiment setup is provided in Appendix C.12. Appendix D provides additional visualizations.

    计算量说明。我们的目标是研究对弱先验的鲁棒性，而非提供计算量匹配的基准。因此每种方法都在其默认设置下报告；计算量匹配的比较见附录 C.11。

    English original
    Compute note. Our goal is to study robustness to weak priors rather than to provide a compute-matched benchmark. We therefore report each method under its default settings; compute-matched comparisons are given in Appendix C.11.

    4.1 跨域逆问题求解

    English original
    4.1 Cross-Domain Inverse Problem Solving

    回顾弱先验可来自(1) 使用少步采样器或(2) 在不匹配数据集上训练。因此我们设计以下跨域实验，以评估这两类弱先验下的性能。

    English original
    Recall that weak priors can arise either from (1) using a few-step sampler or (2) training on a mismatched dataset. We therefore design the following cross-domain experiments to evaluate performance under both types of weak priors.

    我们考虑四个复原任务：修补、高斯去模糊、4 倍超分辨率与非线性去模糊，对象为卧室、教堂与人脸图像。对每个「任务–数据集」组合（例如人脸修补），我们用 DPS 算法 (Chung 等, 2023) 在强先验下基准重建，该算法使用在目标图像同分布上训练的 1000 步 DDPM。随后与两种弱先验设定比较：在匹配数据集上训练的 3 步 DDIM 先验，以及在不匹配数据集（例如 LSUN-Church 或 LSUN-Bedroom）上训练的 3 步 DDIM 先验。对每个弱先验，我们按第 2.1 节所述，用我们的优化器与 HoldoutTopK 早停策略做初始噪声优化来求解相应任务。我们遵循 (Wang 等, 2024) 的建议选择 3 步 DDIM 先验，该工作包含关于 DDIM 步数的消融。

    English original
    We consider four restoration tasks: inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, 4×4\times4× super-resolution, and nonlinear deblurring for bedroom, church, and human face images. For each task–dataset pair (e.g., human face inpainting), we benchmark reconstruction under a strong prior using the DPS algorithm (Chung et al., 2023), which uses a 100010001000-step DDPM trained on the same distribution as the target image. We then compare against two weak-prior settings: a 3-step DDIM prior trained on matched dataset, and a 3-step DDIM prior trained on mismatched dataset (e.g., LSUN-Church or LSUN-Bedroom). For each weak prior, we solve the corresponding task using initial-noise optimization with our optimizer and HoldoutTopK early-stopping strategy, as described in Section 2.1. We choose a 333-step DDIM prior following the recommendation of (Wang et al., 2024), which includes an ablation study over the number of DDIM steps.

    表 3 报告修补与 4 倍超分辨率的结果，其余任务见附录 C。结果表明弱先验也能取得准确重建。使用初始噪声优化时，少步域内先验在全部指标上总体超过 DPS 基线（后者使用域内 1000 步先验）。例如，我们的方法在修补上取得 0.88–1.80 dB 的 PSNR 增益，在超分辨率上增益更大。这些结果也与 (Wang 等, 2024) 和 (Chihaoui 等, 2024) 一致。有些令人惊讶的是，即使使用最弱的先验（域外且少步生成器），性能仍可匹配或超过 DPS。例如，用卧室预训练模型做 CelebA 修补，我们的方法取得 PSNR 32.76，而 DPS 为 31.98。因此这些结果表明，即使少步、域外的扩散生成器也能充当有效先验。 [1]

    English original
    Table 3 reports results for inpainting and 4×4\times4×super-resolution, with the remaining tasks deferred to Appendix C. The results suggest weak prior can achieve accurate reconstructions. With initial-noise optimization, the few-step, in-domain prior overall outperforms the DPS baseline (which uses an in-domain, 100010001000-step prior) across all metrics. For example, our method achieves a PSNR gain of 0.880.880.88–1.801.801.80 dB on inpainting, and an even larger gain on super-resolution. These results are also consistent with (Wang et al., 2024) and (Chihaoui et al., 2024). Somewhat surprisingly, even with the weakest prior (out-of-domain and few-step generator), performance can still match or exceed DPS. For example, using a bedroom-pretrained model for CelebA inpainting, our method achieves PSNR 32.7632.7632.76, compared to DPS's 31.9831.9831.98. Thus, these results show that even few-step, out-of-domain diffusion generators can serve as effective priors.

    我们还研究域不匹配如何影响重建质量。具体地，我们比较方法在匹配与不匹配源–目标域下使用少步生成器的表现。如表 3 所示，域内生成器优于域外生成器。差距有时中等（例如 CelebA 修补），有时很小（例如 Bedroom 修补）。与此同时，使用卧室训练模型与使用教堂训练模型往往表现相近，尤其是与 CelebA 训练模型相比。这符合直觉：卧室与教堂彼此比与人脸更相似。这些比较说明域不匹配会影响性能，但影响常常温和——源域与目标域在视觉上越接近，影响越小；越远则越大。

    English original
    We also study how domain mismatch affects reconstruction quality. Specifically, we compare our method using a few-step generator under matched versus mismatched source–target domains. As shown in Table 3, the in-domain generator outperforms the out-of-domain generator. The gap is sometimes moderate (e.g., CelebA inpainting) and sometimes small (e.g., Bedroom inpainting). Meanwhile, using a bedroom-trained model versus a church-trained model often yields similar performance, especially compared with CelebA-trained model. This matches the intuition that bedrooms and churches are more similar to each other than to human faces. These comparisons suggest that domain mismatch can affect performance, but the effect is often modest, smaller when the source and target domains are visually closer and larger when they are farther apart.

    4.2 与基于优化的方法比较及消融

    English original
    4.2 Comparison with Optimization-Based Methods and Ablations

    接下来，我们把方法与最先进的基于优化的方法 DMPlug (Wang 等, 2024) 比较。两者都优化初始噪声，但优化器与早停策略不同。为隔离算法设计的影响，我们使用相同的域内 3 步 DDIM 先验（如 (Wang 等, 2024) 所建议），并从相同的随机采样初始噪声、以相同迭代数运行两种算法。随机修补与非线性去模糊的结果汇总于表 4，其他任务结果见附录 C。我们的 PSNR 在多数情况下超过 DMPlug，增益为 0.15 到 1 dB；其余情形差异低于 0.1 dB。我们的 LPIPS 一致低于 DMPlug，最多改进 30%。

    English original
    Next, we compare our method with the state-of-the-art optimization-based approach DMPlug (Wang et al., 2024). Both methods optimize the initial noise, but with different optimizers and early-stopping strategies. To isolate the effect of algorithmic design, we use the same in-domain 333-step DDIM prior (as suggested in (Wang et al., 2024)) and run both algorithms from the same randomly sampled initial noise, for the same number of iterations. Results for random inpainting and nonlinear deblurring are summarized in Table 4. Other tasks results are provided in Appendix C. Our PSNR exceeds DMPlug in most cases, with gains ranging from 0.150.150.15 to 111 dB; in the remaining cases, the difference is below 0.10.10.1 dB. Our LPIPS is consistently lower than DMPlug’s, with improvement up to 30%30\%30%.

    我们还对新优化器 AdamSphere 与早停策略 HoldoutTopK 做了小规模消融，结果见表 5。结果表明 AdamSphere 匹配标准 Adam 的优化性能，同时显式地把噪声保持在典型高斯壳层附近——已有研究发现这对高质量生成很重要 (Yang 等, 2024)、(Mannering 等, 2025)。同时，HoldoutTopK 一致优于 (Wang 等, 2024) 所用的基于方差的早停基线。因此，我们的策略为减少过拟合提供了一个简单有效的替代方案。

    English original
    We also include a small ablation study of our new optimizer, AdamSphere, and our early-stopping strategy, HoldoutTopK; the results are reported in Table 5. They indicate that AdamSphere matches the optimization performance of standard Adam, while explicitly keeping the noise near the typical Gaussian shell, which has been found important for high-quality generation (Yang et al., 2024); (Mannering et al., 2025). Meanwhile, HoldoutTopK consistently improves over the variance-based early-stopping baseline used in (Wang et al., 2024). Thus, our strategy offers a simple, effective alternative for reducing overfitting.

    4.3 失败模式

    English original
    4.3 Failure Modes

    我们考察弱先验的局限。为此考虑盒状修补与大尺度超分辨率，它们更接近生成而非重建。例如，盒状修补要求填充整个区域。

    English original
    We examine the limitations of weak priors. To study this, we consider box inpainting and large-scale super-resolution, which are closer to generation than reconstruction. For example, box inpainting requires filling an entire region.

    两个实验中目标都是恢复教堂图像。与之前一样，DPS 使用在 Church 上训练的完整 1000 步 DDPM 先验，而我们的方法分别使用在 Church（域内）与 CelebA（域外）上训练的 3 步 DDIM 先验。对盒状修补，我们遮住一块连续方形区域，其尺寸随试验增大，并把方法与 DPS 基线比较。结果绘于图 4，记录在附录 C 的表 12。我们观察到一个清晰的失败模式：随着被遮比例增大，我们的方法退化并比 DPS 差，性能差距随遮罩变严重而扩大。特别地，域外先验完全失败，这在指标与图 3 顶行中都有体现：填充区域呈现类似人脸的样貌，明显与教堂内容不一致。超分辨率也出现类似观察：随着超分辨率倍数增大，性能急剧退化，几乎所有方法都失败。然而如图 3 底行所示，DPS 凭借更强先验仍能生成更高质量的样本；相比之下，弱先验产生模糊、不一致的样本。

    English original
    In both experiments, the goal is to recover church images. As before, DPS uses a full 100010001000-step DDPM prior trained on Church, while our method uses a 333-step DDIM prior trained on Church (in-domain) and on CelebA (out-of-domain), respectively. For box inpainting, we mask a contiguous square region whose size increases across trials, and compare our method against the DPS baseline. Results are plotted in Figure 4 and recorded in Table 12 in Appendix C. We observe a clear failure mode: as the masked fraction increases, our method degrades and performs worse than DPS, with the performance gap growing as masking becomes more severe. In particular, the out-of-domain prior fails completely, as reflected in both the metrics and Figure 3 top row. The filled region has a face-like appearance that is clearly inconsistent with the church content. Similar observations appear for super-resolution. As the super-resolution factor increases, performance degrades sharply and essentially all methods fail. However, as shown in Figure 3 bottom row, DPS still generates higher-quality samples due to its stronger prior. In contrast, weak priors produce blurry, inconsistent samples.

    4.4 ImageNet 上的潜空间扩散应用

    English original
    4.4 Latent Diffusion Applications on ImageNet

    我们测试使用 Stable Diffusion 2.1 (Rombach 等, 2022) 与 DiT (Peebles 与 Xie, 2023) 的少步潜空间扩散先验。结果报告在附录 C.7 的表 13，呈现相同的定性规律：少步潜空间先验在数据信息量充足的设定下仍能给出准确重建。

    English original
    We test few-step latent diffusion priors using Stable Diffusion 2.1 (Rombach et al., 2022) and DiT (Peebles & Xie, 2023). These results, reported in Table 13 in Appendix C.7, show the same qualitative pattern: few-step latent priors still give accurate reconstructions in data-informative settings.

    5 结论、实用指南与讨论

    English original
    5 Conclusion, Practical Guide, and Discussion

    本文研究逆问题性能何时对先验选择具有鲁棒性。我们表明，弱先验——无论来自低保真生成器还是训练–重建域的失配——在许多逆问题上仍能表现良好。为解释这一现象，我们把贝叶斯一致性理论与局部相关性诊断结合起来。理论表明，信息量足够大的测量可以通过把后验集中在与测量一致的信号附近来降低对先验的敏感度。相关性诊断表明，弱且不匹配的自然图像先验仍可与更强的匹配先验共享局部空间结构。合起来，这些结果解释了弱先验为何能在数据信息量充足的区间生效，以及为何在测量提供的锚点太少时失败。

    English original
    This work studies when inverse-problem performance is robust to the choice of prior. We show that weak priors, arising either from low-fidelity generators or from training–reconstruction domain mismatch, can still perform well across many inverse problems. To explain this phenomenon, we combine Bayesian-consistency theory with local-correlation diagnostics. The theory shows that sufficiently informative measurements can reduce sensitivity to the prior by concentrating the posterior near a measurement-consistent signal. The correlation diagnostics show that weak and mismatched natural-image priors can still share local spatial structure with stronger matched priors. Together, these results explain why weak priors can work in data-informative regimes and why they fail when measurements provide too few anchors.

    在实践上，我们的结果给出一个简单指南：当测量提供大量局部锚点时（如随机修补、去模糊与中等倍率超分辨率），弱先验是有用的默认选择。在这些设定中，重建主要由观测驱动，先验帮助通过共享空间结构传播局部约束。当观测留下大零空间、噪声很高、或需要全局语义补全时（如大面积盒状修补或高倍率超分辨率），更强的匹配先验变得更重要。

    English original
    Practically, our results suggest a simple guide: weak priors are useful defaults when measurements provide many local anchors, as in random inpainting, deblurring, and moderate super-resolution. In these settings, reconstruction is driven largely by the observation, while the prior helps propagate local constraints through shared spatial structure. Stronger matched priors become more important when the observation leaves a large null space, has high noise, or requires global semantic completion, as in large box inpainting or high-factor super-resolution.

    展望未来，这一现象要求进一步研究为弱先验（尤其是少步先验）量身定制的算法。尽管初始噪声优化表现强劲，现有工作仍有限，且大多集中在这一条路径上。可能的算法改进包括把测量注入与噪声优化结合的混合方法，以及更有效的采样过程。在理论方面，需要进一步工作来确定决定「测量何时足够有信息量、从而使弱先验有效」的锐利阈值。

    English original
    Looking forward, this phenomenon calls for further study of algorithms tailored to weak priors, especially few-step priors. Despite the strong performance of initial-noise optimization, existing work remains limited and largely centers on this single approach. Potential algorithmic improvements include hybrid methods that combine measurement injection with noise optimization, and more effective sampling procedures. On the theoretical side, further work is needed to pin down sharp thresholds that determine when measurements are informative enough for weak priors to be effective.

    影响声明

    English original
    Impact Statement

    本文旨在加深对逆问题中扩散模型先验的理解。当测量信息量足够时，它可能有助于减少对昂贵或特定领域生成模型的需求。同时，我们的结果表明，弱先验或不匹配先验在低信息量区间可能失败，例如大面积盒状修补或高倍率超分辨率，那里重建可能包含看似合理但结构错误的内容。因此在医学或科学成像等高风险场景中，这类重建只应在适当的验证、不确定性检查与领域专业知识下使用。

    English original
    This work aims to improve the understanding of diffusion-model priors for inverse problems. It may help reduce the need for expensive or domain-specific generative models when measurements are sufficiently informative. At the same time, our results show that weak or mismatched priors can fail in low-information regimes, such as large box inpainting or high-factor super-resolution, where reconstructions may contain plausible but incorrect structure. In high-stakes settings such as medical or scientific imaging, such reconstructions should therefore be used only with appropriate validation, uncertainty checks, and domain expertise.

    A.3 异质方差下的后验坍缩

    A.3 Posterior collapse under heterogeneous variances

    这里我们在异质方差假设下证明定理 3 的一个更一般版本。

    English original
    Here we prove a more general version of Theorem 3 under a heterogeneous-variance assumption.

    设定：考虑测量模型 y=Ax+ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im),\displaystyle y = Ax + \epsilon,\qquad \epsilon\sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m), y=Ax+ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​), 与高斯混合 π(x)=∑j=1Mwj φ(x;μj,τj2In),wj≥0, ∑j=1Mwj=1.\displaystyle \pi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^M w_j\,\varphi\big(x;\mu_j,\tau_j^2 I_n\big), \qquad w_j\ge 0,\ \sum_{j=1}^M w_j=1. π(x)=j=1∑M​wj​φ(x;μj​,τj2​In​),wj​≥0, j=1∑M​wj​=1.

    Setup: Consider the measurement model y=Ax+ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im),\displaystyle y = Ax + \epsilon,\qquad \epsilon\sim \mathbb{N}(0,\sigma^2 I_m), y=Ax+ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,σ2Im​), and the Gaussian mixture π(x)=∑j=1Mwj φ ⁣(x;μj,τj2In),wj≥0, ∑j=1Mwj=1.\displaystyle \pi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^M w_j\,\varphi\!\big(x;\mu_j,\tau_j^2 I_n\big), \qquad w_j\ge 0,\ \sum_{j=1}^M w_j=1. π(x)=j=1∑M​wj​φ(x;μj​,τj2​In​),wj​≥0, j=1∑M​wj​=1.

    B AdamSphere 与 HoldoutTopK 的细节

    English original
    B Details of AdamSphere and HoldoutTopK

    AdamSphere 优化器。在扩散逆问题中优化初始噪声变量 zzz 时，我们施加球面约束 ∥z∥2=r\|z\|_2=r∥z∥2​=r（rrr 固定，或设为初始化时的 ∥z(0)∥2\|z^{(0)}\|_2∥z(0)∥2​）。这防止优化器轻率地改变噪声幅度，并把搜索保持在先验的典型集合内。AdamSphere 优化器把 Adam 适配到这一约束：每次迭代，我们先把欧氏梯度投影到当前迭代点处球面的切空间，用该切向梯度做 Adam 的动量更新，再把预条件后的搜索方向投影回切空间。最后沿该切向方向走一步，并拉回球面。

    English original
    AdamSphere optimizer. When optimizing the initial noise variable zzz in diffusion-based inverse problems, we enforce the spherical constraint ∥z∥2=r\|z\|_2=r∥z∥2​=r (with rrr fixed, or set to ∥z(0)∥2\|z^{(0)}\|_2∥z(0)∥2​ at initialization). This prevents the optimizer from trivially changing the noise magnitude and keeps the search within the typical set of the Gaussian prior. AdamSphere optimizer adapts Adam to this constraint: at each iteration, we first project the Euclidean gradient onto the tangent space of the sphere at the current iterate, apply Adam’s moment updates using this tangent gradient, and then project the preconditioned search direction back to the tangent space. Finally, we take a step along this tangent direction and retract back to the sphere.

    默认情况下我们使用简单的归一化拉回（把更新后的向量重新缩放到范数 rrr），也考虑沿球面大圆移动的指数映射拉回（在球面 Srd−1={z:∥z∥2=r}\mathbb{S}^{d-1}_r=\{z:\|z\|_2=r\}Srd−1​={z:∥z∥2​=r} 上，对满足 ⟨u,z⟩=0\langle u,z\rangle=0⟨u,z⟩=0 的切向 uuu，步长 η\etaη 的指数映射拉回为 Expz(ηu)=zcos⁡ ⁣(η∥u∥2r)+ru∥u∥2sin⁡ ⁣(η∥u∥2r),\displaystyle \mathrm{Exp}_z(\eta u) = z\cos\!\left(\frac{\eta\|u\|_2}{r}\right) + r\frac{u}{\|u\|_2} \sin\!\left(\frac{\eta\|u\|_2}{r}\right), Expz​(ηu)=zcos(rη∥u∥2​​)+r∥u∥2​u​sin(rη∥u∥2​​), 其中 u=0u=0u=0 的情形按连续性定义为 Expz(0)=z\mathrm{Exp}_z(0)=zExpz​(0)=z。）

    English original
    We use the simple normalization retraction by default (rescale the updated vector to norm rrr), and also consider an exponential-map retraction that moves along a great circle on the sphere (on the sphere Srd−1={z:∥z∥2=r}\mathbb{S}^{d-1}_r=\{z:\|z\|_2=r\}Srd−1​={z:∥z∥2​=r}, for a tangent direction uuu satisfying ⟨u,z⟩=0\langle u,z\rangle=0⟨u,z⟩=0, the exponential-map retraction with step size η\etaη is Expz(ηu)=zcos⁡ ⁣(η∥u∥2r)+ru∥u∥2sin⁡ ⁣(η∥u∥2r),\displaystyle \mathrm{Exp}_z(\eta u) = z\cos\!\left(\frac{\eta\|u\|_2}{r}\right) + r\frac{u}{\|u\|_2} \sin\!\left(\frac{\eta\|u\|_2}{r}\right), Expz​(ηu)=zcos(rη∥u∥2​​)+r∥u∥2​u​sin(rη∥u∥2​​), with the case u=0u=0u=0 defined by continuity as Expz(0)=z\mathrm{Exp}_z(0)=zExpz​(0)=z.)

    HoldoutTopK 早停。优化初始噪声时，较晚的迭代可能开始过拟合观测像素：测量误差持续下降，但视觉质量（或 PSNR/LPIPS 等指标）可能变差。为避免过拟合，我们使用一个简单的基于留出的早停规则 HoldoutTopK。我们把观测索引集 Ω\OmegaΩ 随机分成用于优化的拟合子集 Ωfit\Omega_{\mathrm{fit}}Ωfit​ 与从不参与梯度更新的不相交留出子集 Ωho\Omega_{\mathrm{ho}}Ωho​。在每次迭代 ttt，我们计算留出分数（例如 Ωho\Omega_{\mathrm{ho}}Ωho​ 上的 MSE），并保留留出分数最低的 KKK 个迭代。随后从这个前 KKK 集合中选出一个迭代输出（例如取前 KKK 中最好的，或在前 KKK 中均匀随机抽取）。

    English original
    HoldoutTopK early stopping. When optimizing the initial noise, later iterates can begin to overfit the observed pixels: the measurement error keeps decreasing, but visual quality (or metrics such as PSNR/LPIPS) may deteriorate. To avoid overfitting, we use a simple holdout-based early-stopping rule, HoldoutTopK. We randomly split the observed index set Ω\OmegaΩ into a fit subset Ωfit\Omega_{\mathrm{fit}}Ωfit​ used for optimization and a disjoint holdout subset Ωho\Omega_{\mathrm{ho}}Ωho​ that is never used in gradient updates. At each iteration ttt, we evaluate a holdout score (e.g., the MSE on Ωho\Omega_{\mathrm{ho}}Ωho​) and keep the KKK iterates with the lowest holdout scores. We then output an iterate chosen from this top-KKK set (e.g., the best within the top-KKK, or uniformly at random among them).

    我们的想法受统计机器学习中的标准做法启发：那里用验证集近似测试性能并指导模型选择。但与只挑单一最低误差候选的标准模型选择不同，我们保留误差最低的前 KKK 个迭代，最终返回这前 KKK 个中最新的一次。使用 K>1K>1K>1 可以避免因留出噪声而选中某个虚假的「最佳」迭代，从而稳定选择，同时仍偏向那些持续在未见像素上泛化良好的迭代。在实践中，HoldoutTopK 提供了一种轻量而稳健的过拟合缓解方式。

    English original
    Our idea is inspired by standard practice in statistical machine learning, where a validation set is used to approximate test performance and guide model selection. However, unlike standard model selection that picks the single lowest-error candidate, we keep the top-KKK lowest-error iterates and eventually return the latest iterate among these top KKK. Using K>1K>1K>1 stabilizes selection by avoiding the risk of picking a single spurious “best” iterate due to holdout noise, while still favoring iterates that consistently generalize well to unseen pixels. In practice, HoldoutTopK provides a lightweight and robust way to reduce overfitting.

    C 额外实验结果与实验细节

    English original
    C Additional experiment results and experiment details

    C.1 跨域逆问题求解

    English original
    C.1 Cross-Domain Inverse Problem Solving

    表 6 给出高斯与非线性去模糊的额外跨域结果。与第 4.1 节一致，这些实验进一步确认：弱扩散先验（例如少步或域不匹配的先验）仍与 DPS 基线高度可比。对高斯去模糊，DPS 在域内表现良好，但我们的方法尽管使用弱得多的先验，仍经常在 PSNR 与 SSIM 上超过它。在更具挑战性的非线性去模糊任务上，相同的定性结论成立，并进一步说明弱先验对逆问题是有效且鲁棒的。

    English original
    Table 6 presents additional cross-domain results for Gaussian and nonlinear deblurring. Consistent with Section 4.1, these experiments further confirm that a weak diffusion prior, such as a few-step or domain-mismatched one, remains highly competitive with the DPS baseline. For Gaussian deblurring, DPS performs well in-domain, but our method frequently surpasses it in PSNR and SSIM despite using substantially weaker priors. With the more challenging nonlinear deblurring task, the same qualitative conclusions hold and further demonstrate that weak priors are effective and robust for inverse problems.

    C.2 与基于优化的方法比较

    English original
    C.2 Comparison with Optimization-Based Methods

    表 7 报告方法与 DMPlug 在高斯去模糊与 4 倍超分辨率上的进一步比较。在两个任务、三个数据集上，我们的方法在多数指标上匹配或超过 DMPlug。对高斯去模糊，我们的方法在三个数据集上均提升 PSNR，LPIPS 与 SSIM 也保持有竞争力。对超分辨率，两种方法接近，而我们的方法总体给出更低的 LPIPS 与更高的 SSIM。

    English original
    Table 7 reports further comparisons between our method and DMPlug on Gaussian deblurring and 4×4\times4× super-resolution. Across both tasks and all three datasets, our method matches or outperforms DMPlug in most metrics. For Gaussian deblurring, our method improves PSNR on all three datasets, with consistently competitive LPIPS and SSIM. For super-resolution, the two methods are close, while our method generally yields lower LPIPS and higher SSIM.

    C.3 与额外扩散求解器基线比较：DAPS 与 DiffPIR

    English original
    C.3 Comparison with additional diffusion-solver baseline: DAPS and DiffPIR

    我们把 DAPS 与 DiffPIR 作为额外的基于扩散的逆问题基线。这一比较旨在检验正文结论是否只针对以 DPS 作为全先验基线的情形。我们考虑三个逆任务：随机修补、高斯去模糊与 4 倍超分辨率，在 CelebA-HQ、LSUN Bedroom 与 LSUN Church 上评估。表 8 报告结果。

    English original
    We include DAPS and DiffPIR as additional diffusion-based inverse-problem baselines. This comparison is intended to check whether the conclusions in the main text are specific to using DPS as the full-prior baseline. We consider three inverse tasks: random inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, and 4×4\times4× super-resolution, evaluated on CelebA-HQ, LSUN Bedroom, and LSUN Church. Table 8 reports the results.

    DAPS 在这些任务上是强基线，尤其在感知指标上；而 DiffPIR 在此设定下总体较弱。这些结果为基线格局提供了额外背景，并不改变论文的主要信息。我们的早停初始噪声优化（INO）在弱先验下跨任务取得有竞争力的 PSNR。例如在 CelebA-HQ 修补上，INO 达到 33.78 的 PSNR（见表 3），超过 DAPS（32.35）与 DiffPIR（31.96）。域外设定也保持竞争力：用 Church 训练的先验恢复 CelebA-HQ 图像仍达到 32.62 的 PSNR。

    English original
    DAPS is a strong baseline across these tasks, especially on perceptual metrics, while DiffPIR is generally weaker under this setup. These results provide additional context for the baseline landscape. They do not change the main message of the paper. Our early-stopped initial-noise optimization (INO) under weak priors achieves competitive PSNR across tasks. For example, on CelebA-HQ inpainting, INO reaches a PSNR of 33.78 (see Table 3), outperforming DAPS (32.35) and DiffPIR (31.96). The out-of-domain setting also remains competitive: using a Church-trained prior to recover CelebA-HQ images still achieves a PSNR of 32.62.

    C.4 随机网络弱先验：Deep Random Projector

    English original
    C.4 Random-network weak prior: Deep Random Projector

    我们把 Deep Random Projector（DRP）(Li 等, 2023) 作为随机修补的额外基线。DRP 与我们的设定密切相关，因为它也通过基于优化的生成先验求解逆问题。然而它代表比正文所研究的弱扩散先验更弱的先验：DRP 不使用预训练扩散生成器，而使用随机初始化并冻结的网络。因此它不使用任何学到的数据分布，仅依赖生成器的架构归纳偏置。

    English original
    We include Deep Random Projector (DRP) (Li et al., 2023) as an additional baseline for random inpainting. DRP is closely related to our setting because it also solves inverse problems through an optimization-based generative prior. However, it represents an even weaker prior than the weak diffusion priors studied in the main text: instead of using a pretrained diffusion generator, DRP uses a randomly initialized frozen network. Thus, it does not use any learned data distribution and relies only on the architectural inductive bias of the generator.

    我们在 CelebA-HQ、LSUN Bedroom 与 LSUN Church 的随机修补上评估 DRP，设定与附录 C.12 相同：70% 随机遮罩，观测像素上加 σ=0.01\sigma=0.01σ=0.01 的高斯噪声。所有结果在每个数据集 100 张测试图像上平均。表 9 报告结果。

    English original
    We evaluate DRP on random inpainting for CelebA-HQ, LSUN Bedroom, and LSUN Church, using the same setting as Appendix C.12: 70% random masking with Gaussian noise σ=0.01\sigma=0.01σ=0.01 on the observed pixels. All results are averaged over 100 test images per dataset. Table 9 reports the results.

    DRP 获得合理的重建，说明仅靠架构归纳偏置也能为逆问题提供有用的正则。

    English original
    DRP obtains reasonable reconstructions, showing that architectural inductive bias alone can provide useful regularization for inverse problems.

    然而它一致劣于我们的弱扩散先验。特别地，DRP 的重建明显更模糊，细尺度细节更弱；例子见图 13。与表 3 中域内 3 步扩散先验相比，DRP 在 CelebA-HQ 上低 4.69 dB，在 Bedroom 上低 3.47 dB，在 Church 上低 2.14 dB；其 SSIM 也更低，尤其在 CelebA-HQ 与 Bedroom 上。这些结果支持这样的观点：弱扩散先验并非任意的弱生成器——即使其无条件样本低保真，它们仍携带预训练得到、而随机初始化网络所没有的有用信息。

    English original
    However, it is consistently worse than our weak diffusion prior. In particular, DRP reconstructions are noticeably blurrier and contain weaker fine-scale details; see Figure 13 for an example. Compared with the in-domain 3-step diffusion prior in Table 3, DRP is lower by 4.694.694.69 dB on CelebA-HQ, 3.473.473.47 dB on Bedroom, and 2.142.142.14 dB on Church. Its SSIM is also lower, especially on CelebA-HQ and Bedroom. These results support the view that weak diffusion priors are not arbitrary weak generators: even when their unconditional samples are low-fidelity, they still carry useful information from pretraining that is absent from a randomly initialized network.

    C.5 科学逆问题

    English original
    C.5 Scientific inverse problems

    我们进一步在 InverseBench (Zheng 等, 2025) 的科学逆问题上评估先验不匹配。这些实验有用，因为在科学成像中可能没有匹配良好的预训练生成先验，于是需要复用为不同物理系统训练的先验。

    English original
    We further evaluate prior mismatch on scientific inverse problems from InverseBench (Zheng et al., 2025). These experiments are useful because, in scientific imaging, a well-matched pretrained generative prior may be unavailable, so one may need to reuse a prior trained for a different physical system.

    使用 FWI 先验的线性散射。我们首先考虑线性散射（Linear Scattering）问题。遵循 InverseBench 设定，我们评估 60、180、360 个接收器三种测量设置，对应不同的测量信息量水平。我们使用 InverseBench 提供的全波形反演（FWI）先验作为不匹配先验。该先验与线性散射任务强烈不匹配，因为它是为从全波形测量恢复地下物理属性而训练的。我们比较 DPS、DAPS 与我们的初始噪声优化（INO），所有方法都做了轻度调参。

    English original
    Linear scattering with an FWI prior. We first consider the Linear Scattering problem. Following the InverseBench setup, we evaluate three measurement settings with 606060, 180180180, and 360360360 receivers, corresponding to different levels of measurement informativeness. We use the Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) prior provided by InverseBench as a mismatched prior. This prior is strongly mismatched to the Linear Scattering task, since it is trained for recovering subsurface physical properties from full waveform measurements. We compare DPS, DAPS, and our initial-noise optimization (INO), with all methods lightly tuned.

    表 10 报告 PSNR。与 (Zheng 等, 2025) 表 3 的匹配先验结果相比，匹配先验设定总体仍更强。不过，先验不匹配下的退化是温和的，而非灾难性的。在 180 与 360 个接收器时，重建仍然合理；在 60 个接收器时，INO 甚至取得比 InverseBench 中若干强先验方法更高的 PSNR。在此测试的不匹配先验方法中，INO 在三种接收器设置下都一致优于 DPS 与 DAPS：相对 DPS 的增益在 60、180、360 接收器上分别为 1.68、1.42、1.53 dB；相对 DAPS 的增益为 0.64、2.13、1.31 dB。

    English original
    Table 10 reports PSNR. Compared with the matched-prior results in Table 3 of (Zheng et al., 2025), the matched-prior setting remains stronger overall. Nevertheless, the degradation under prior mismatch is moderate rather than catastrophic. With 180180180 and 360360360 receivers, the reconstructions remain reasonable; with 606060 receivers, INO even attains higher PSNR than several strong-prior methods reported in InverseBench. Among the mismatched-prior methods tested here, INO consistently outperforms both DPS and DAPS across all three receiver settings. The gains over DPS are 1.681.681.68, 1.421.421.42, and 1.531.531.53 dB for 606060, 180180180, and 360360360 receivers, respectively; the gains over DAPS are 0.640.640.64, 2.132.132.13, and 1.311.311.31 dB.

    非线性黑洞成像。我们还评估 InverseBench 中的非线性黑洞成像（Black Hole Imaging）问题。我们比较匹配先验与不匹配先验，其中不匹配先验取自线性散射模型并调整到黑洞成像的分辨率。表 11 报告 PSNR 与模糊 PSNR（blur PSNR）。

    English original
    Nonlinear black hole imaging. We also evaluate the nonlinear Black Hole Imaging problem from InverseBench. We compare a matched prior with a mismatched prior, where the mismatched prior is taken from the Linear Scattering model and resized to the Black Hole Imaging resolution. Table 11 reports PSNR and blur PSNR.

    在匹配先验下，DPS 给出最好的 PSNR，其后是 INO 与 DAPS。然而在先验不匹配下，INO 成为三者中最强的方法：其 PSNR 相对 DPS 与 DAPS 分别高 2.04 dB 与 2.82 dB，模糊 PSNR 分别高 2.41 dB 与 3.48 dB。INO 从匹配先验设定到不匹配先验设定的退化也最小。

    English original
    Under the matched prior, DPS gives the best PSNR, followed by INO and DAPS. Under prior mismatch, however, INO becomes the strongest method among the three: it improves over DPS and DAPS by 2.042.042.04 dB and 2.822.822.82 dB in PSNR, respectively, and by 2.412.412.41 dB and 3.483.483.48 dB in blur PSNR. INO also has the smallest degradation from the matched-prior setting to the mismatched-prior setting.

    同时，这些结果应谨慎解读。INO 在计算上比 DPS 与 DAPS 慢，因为它在初始噪声上求解迭代优化问题。此外，虽然 INO 在 PSNR 与模糊 PSNR 上表现良好，其他物理感知指标（如 χ2\chi^2χ2）在我们的实验中并不占优。这说明对科学逆问题，仅用简单的像素或图像空间重建损失优化初始噪声可能不够；可能需要更好的任务特定损失，包括与前向模型或 χ2\chi^2χ2 等物理统计量挂钩的损失，才能使 INO 与科学成像所用的评价标准对齐。

    English original
    At the same time, these results should be interpreted with some care. INO is computationally slower than DPS and DAPS because it solves an iterative optimization problem over the initial noise. In addition, although INO performs well in PSNR and blur PSNR, other physics-aware metrics such as χ2\chi^2χ2 are less favorable in our experiments. This suggests that, for scientific inverse problems, optimizing the initial noise with a simple pixel- or image-space reconstruction loss may not be enough. Better task-specific loss functions, including losses tied to the forward model or physics-based statistics such as χ2\chi^2χ2, may be needed to align INO with the evaluation criteria used in scientific imaging.

    这些科学逆问题实验支持论文的主要信息：当测量有信息量时，弱先验仍能给出有用的重建。同时，匹配与不匹配先验之间的差距在这里似乎比自然图像实验更大。一个可能原因是，不同科学领域之间共享的局部空间结构可能少于自然图像领域，因此不匹配先验可供从测量传播的结构信息更少。这些结果也指出未来工作的一个重要方向：对科学逆问题，初始噪声优化的目标函数应当针对科学任务与评价指标设计，而不是只依赖通用的图像空间重建损失。

    English original
    These scientific inverse-problem experiments support the main message of the paper: weak priors can still give useful reconstructions when the measurements are informative. At the same time, the gap between matched and mismatched priors appears larger here than in our natural-image experiments. One possible reason is that different scientific domains may share less local spatial structure than natural-image domains, so a mismatched prior has less transferable structural information to propagate from the measurements. These results also point to an important direction for future work: for scientific inverse problems, the optimization objective for initial-noise optimization should be designed to match the scientific task and evaluation metric, rather than relying only on generic image-space reconstruction losses.

    C.6 失败模式

    English original
    C.6 Failure Modes

    表 12 给出盒状修补的完整定量结果；目标是重建教堂图像，同时遮住越来越大的方形区域。对中等遮罩尺寸（0.3×0.30.3\times0.30.3×0.3 与 0.4×0.40.4\times0.40.4×0.4），我们的域内弱先验仍与 DPS 有竞争力。然而当遮罩增大到 0.5×0.50.5\times0.50.5×0.5 与 0.6×0.60.6\times0.60.6×0.6 时，DPS 开始在 PSNR 与 LPIPS 上占优，而我们的域内变体明显退化，如图 14 的额外可视化所示。这确认了结论：弱扩散先验对偏重重建的逆问题仍然有效，但在偏重生成的设定中会遇到根本限制。

    English original
    Table 12 provides the full quantitative results for box inpainting, where the goal is to reconstruct Church images while masking increasingly large square regions. For moderate mask sizes (0.3×0.30.3\times0.30.3×0.3 and 0.4×0.40.4\times0.40.4×0.4), our in-domain weak prior remains competitive with DPS. However, as the masked region grows to 0.5×0.50.5\times0.50.5×0.5 and 0.6×0.60.6\times0.60.6×0.6, DPS begins to dominate in both PSNR and LPIPS, while our in-domain variant exhibits noticeable degradation, as illustrated in the additional visualizations in Figure 14. This confirms the conclusion that weak diffusion priors remain effective for reconstruction-focused inverse problems but encounter fundamental limitations in generation-heavy settings.

    大尺度超分辨率呈现类似趋势。16 倍超分辨率的定性结果见图 15：用 CelebA 预训练模型生成的域外重建在用于教堂图像时，开始出现类似人脸的结构。

    English original

    C.9 使用不匹配先验的 DPS

    English original
    C.9 DPS with mismatched priors

    为把域不匹配的影响与逆问题求解器的选择分开，我们还评估使用匹配与不匹配完整扩散先验的 DPS。在主要实验中，DPS 使用在目标域上训练的完整扩散先验。这里我们保持求解器为 DPS 不变，只改变预训练扩散模型的源域。这样就把域匹配轴与采样器强度轴隔离开来。

    English original
    To separate the effect of domain mismatch from the choice of inverse solver, we also evaluate DPS with matched and mismatched full diffusion priors. In the main experiments, DPS uses a full diffusion prior trained on the target domain. Here, we keep the solver fixed as DPS, but vary the source domain of the pretrained diffusion model. This isolates the domain-match axis from the sampler-strength axis.

    表 15 报告非线性去模糊任务的结果，并包含匹配先验行作为参照。如预期，匹配先验通常对每个目标数据集给出最佳性能。然而先验不匹配下的退化并非在所有情形都灾难性。对 Church 与 Bedroom 目标，不匹配先验在 PSNR 上仍接近匹配的 DPS 基线；而 CelebA-HQ 对源域不匹配更敏感。这些结果支持「不匹配先验仍能提供有用重建性能」的观点。

    Table 15 reports results for the nonlinear deblurring task. The matched-prior rows are included as references. As expected, the matched prior usually gives the best performance for each target dataset. However, the degradation under prior mismatch is not catastrophic in all cases. For Church and Bedroom targets, mismatched priors remain close to the matched DPS baseline in PSNR, while CelebA-HQ is more sensitive to source-domain mismatch. These results support the view that mismatched priors can still provide useful reconstruction performance.

    C.10 对测量噪声的敏感性

    C.10 Sensitivity to measurement noise

    我们进一步研究测量噪声如何影响先验敏感性。我们改变高斯噪声水平 σ∈{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0}\sigma \in \{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0\}σ∈{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0}，比较使用强域内先验的 DPS 与在域内、域外设定下使用弱先验的初始噪声优化（INO）方法。表 16 报告 PSNR、LPIPS、SSIM 以及 INO 选中的早停轮次。

    English original
    We further study how measurement noise affects prior sensitivity. We vary the Gaussian noise level σ∈{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0}\sigma \in \{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0\}σ∈{0.01,0.05,0.2,0.5,1.0} and compare DPS, which uses a strong in-domain prior, with our initial-noise optimization (INO) method using weak priors in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Table 16 reports PSNR, LPIPS, SSIM, and the selected early-stopping epoch for INO.

    结果表明 INO 在低与中等噪声水平下极具竞争力。对 σ≤0.5\sigma\leq 0.5σ≤0.5，域内 INO 取得最好的 PSNR 与 SSIM，域外 INO 变体也仍然有用。然而随着噪声水平升高，域内与域外 INO 之间的差距变大。在 σ=1.0\sigma=1.0σ=1.0 时，使用强域内先验的 DPS 超过两个 INO 变体。这与我们的失败模式图景一致：当测量含噪时，它们提供的可靠局部锚点更少，重建更依赖先验的强度与域匹配。

    English original
    The results show that INO is highly competitive at low and moderate noise levels. For σ≤0.5\sigma\leq 0.5σ≤0.5, in-domain INO achieves the best PSNR and SSIM, and the out-of-domain INO variant also remains useful. However, as the noise level increases, the gap between in-domain and out-of-domain INO becomes larger. At σ=1.0\sigma=1.0σ=1.0, DPS with a strong in-domain prior outperforms both INO variants. This is consistent with our failure-mode picture: when measurements are noisy, they provide fewer reliable local anchors, and reconstruction becomes more dependent on the strength and domain match of the prior.

    C.11 关于与基线算法的计算可比性

    English original
    C.11 On computational comparability with baseline algorithms

    INO 与 DMPlug 使用相同的初始噪声优化框架，因此为公平起见，我们在所有比较中使用完全相同的优化预算。

    English original
    INO and DMPlug both use the same initial-noise optimization framework, so we use the exact same optimization budget in all comparisons to ensure fairness.

    DPS 与 INO 分配计算的方式有根本不同，因此严格的等计算量比较并不直接。更具体地说：

    English original
    DPS and INO allocate computation in fundamentally different ways, so a strict compute-matched comparison is not straightforward. More precisely
    • 一旦设定反向扩散步数，DPS 的每次运行成本基本固定：每个反向步大致涉及一次去噪器评估，因此总成本由链长决定。此外，已有研究 (Ma 等, 2025) 表明增加链长的扩展性很差，因此 DPS 的预算通常被视为基本固定。人们通常按任务选择 500 或 1000 个反向步。
    • INO 通过初始噪声优化的迭代数来调节计算预算。每次迭代需要运行一次 KKK 步 DDIM 生成，因此主导成本随迭代数与 DDIM 步数之积增长。在我们的实验中，通常使用 3 步 DDIM 与 500 次优化迭代。
    English original
  • DPS has an essentially fixed per-run cost once the number of reverse diffusion steps is set: each reverse step involves roughly one denoiser evaluation, so the total cost is driven by the chain length. Moreover, existing studies (Ma et al., 2025) suggest that increasing the chain length scales poorly, so the DPS budget is typically treated as effectively fixed. People typically choose 500 or 1000 reverse steps depending on the task.
  • INO has a tunable compute budget through the number of initial-noise optimization iterations. Each iteration requires running a KKK-step DDIM generation, so the dominant cost scales with the product of the iteration count and the DDIM step count. In our experiments, we typically use a 333-step DDIM and 500500500 iterations of optimization.

    • 在第 4 节的实验中，单次 INO 运行的计算量约为单次 DPS 运行的 1.5 到 3 倍。这一比较仍适合我们的主要目的，即研究先验的影响。具体地，我们的目标是检验弱先验能否在数据信息量充足的区间求解逆问题，而不是声称 INO 一致更高效或一致优于 DPS。因此我们关注定性行为与 PSNR、SSIM 等重建指标，而不把主要比较当作严格的等计算量效率基准。此外，一旦扩散链长固定，DPS 没有可直接对应的旋钮来使用额外计算。为完整起见，下面也给出显式的等计算量比较。

    English original
    In our experiments in Section 4, a single run of INO costs about 1.5×\times× to 3×\times× as much compute as a single DPS run. This comparison is still suitable for our main purpose, which is to study the effect of the prior. Specifically, our goal is to test whether weak priors can solve inverse problems in data-informative regimes, rather than to claim that INO is uniformly more efficient or uniformly better than DPS. We therefore focus on qualitative behavior and reconstruction metrics such as PSNR and SSIM, instead of treating the main comparison as a strictly compute-matched efficiency benchmark. Moreover, once the diffusion chain length is fixed, DPS does not have a directly comparable knob for using additional compute. For completeness, we also include an explicitly compute-matched comparison below.

    表 17 报告 CelebA-HQ 修补上同时按函数评估次数（NFE）与墙钟时间的匹配成本比较。INO 比 DPS 使用更多内存，但能有效利用额外计算。在约 1000 NFE 时，333 次优化迭代的 INO 达到 31.86 PSNR，接近 1000 NFE 的 DPS 的 32.27 PSNR。在约 3000 NFE 时，INO 达到 34.13 PSNR，而 DPS 取三次运行中最好为 32.36 PSNR。即使与取五次运行最好的 DPS（使用 5000 NFE 且墙钟时间多于 INO）相比，INO 仍取得更高的重建质量。这些结果表明 INO 比单次 DPS 运行更昂贵，但提供了可控的成本–质量权衡。

    English original
    Table 17 reports matched-cost comparisons on CelebA-HQ inpainting using both number of function evaluations (NFE) and wall-clock time. INO uses more memory than DPS, but it can use additional compute effectively. At about 1000 NFE, INO with 333 optimization iterations reaches 31.86 PSNR, close to DPS with 1000 NFE at 32.27 PSNR. At about 3000 NFE, INO reaches 34.13 PSNR, compared with 32.36 PSNR for DPS using the best of three runs. Even compared with DPS using the best of five runs, which uses 5000 NFE and more wall-clock time than INO, INO still achieves higher reconstruction quality. These results show that INO is more expensive than a single DPS run, but provides a controllable cost–quality tradeoff.

    D.1 不同先验下的重建过程

    English original
    D.1 Reconstruction Process with Different Priors

    图 5–图 10 展示我们的初始噪声优化算法在域内与域外先验下恢复图像的结果。

    English original
    Figure 5–Figure 10 show results of our initial-noise optimization algorithm for recovering images using both in-distribution and out-of-distribution priors.

    D.2 潜空间扩散应用的重建结果

    English original
    D.2 Reconstruction Result for Latent Diffusion Application

    图 11 与 图 12 展示若干潜空间扩散算法的重建结果。我们用 SD2.1 与 DiT 两种先验实现我们的方法。

    English original
    Figure 11 and Figure 12 show reconstruction results for several latent diffusion algorithms. We implement our methods using both SD2.1 and DiT priors.

    D.3 使用 DRP 先验的重建

    English original
    D.3 Reconstruction using DRP prior

    图 13 可视化使用 DRP 先验得到的重建。由于 DRP 使用随机初始化的生成器，其重建明显更模糊，细尺度细节更弱。

    English original
    Figure 13 visualizes reconstructions obtained with the DRP prior. Because DRP uses a randomly initialized generator, its reconstructions are noticeably blurrier and contain weaker fine-scale details.

    D.4 重建失败案例

    English original
    D.4 Reconstruction Failure Case

    图 14 与 图 15 可视化 DPS 与我们的方法在盒状修补和超分辨率上的结果，我们的方法给出域内与域外两种弱先验。失败模式从重建的不一致中清晰可见。

    English original
    Figure 14 and Figure 15 visualize box inpainting and super-resolution results for DPS and our method. Our method is shown with both in-domain and out-of-domain weak priors. The failure mode is evident from the reconstruction inconsistencies.

    脚注

    • [1]

      尽管我们的方法在这些指标上常常优于 DPS，我们并不声称弱先验一般优于强先验。DPS 是广泛使用的强先验基线，但它未必是每个任务或数据集上最好的逆问题求解器。不过，相对 DPS 的一致增益说明：当测量信息足够充分时，弱的、甚至域外的先验在实践中也可以有效。

      Although our method often outperforms DPS on these metrics, we do not claim that a weak prior is generally better than a strong prior. DPS is a widely used strong-prior baseline, but it is not necessarily the best inverse-problem solver for every task or dataset. Still, consistent gains over DPS show that weak, even out-of-domain priors can be practically effective when the measurements are sufficiently informative.
